statement: Exposure/awareness and an available CTA do not identify incremental delivery without outcome/counterfactual data.
world_A: Awareness rises; the same already-interested customers buy as before.
world_B: Awareness rises; previously unreached eligible customers deliver additional purchases.
result: Both satisfy early-stage observations; downstream effect is unidentified.
Identical visit cadence can coexist with different work quantities.
Holding job, price and direct cost constant, changing booking channel or payer alone does not add job GP.
A capped top-up does not provide the full floor in this illustration.
